text: On Sundays andpublic holidays, most shops in Berlin must close, but there are exceptions. This guide shows you where to buy groceries and other things when all the stores are closed.

These businesses can open on Sundays:4 Shops in train stations, airports and bus terminals Restaurants and food delivery Cafés Bakeries ManySpätis5 Petrol stations Pharmacies (Apotheken) Tourist attractions and souvenir shops Flea markets and art markets Museums

title: Supermarkets
text: Those train station supermarkets open on Sundays:1 Friedrichstraße(Mitte):Edeka,go AsiaandVitalia Gesundbrunnen(Wedding):Denns Biomarkt Hauptbahnhof(Mitte):REWE CityandDenns Biomarkt Lichtenberg:Edeka Ostbahnhof(Friedrichshain):REWEandPenny Ostkreuz(Friedrichshain):Denns Biomarkt Potsdamer Platz(Mitte):SPAR Expressandgo asia Südkreuz(Schöneberg):Edeka Zoologischer Garten(Charlottenburg):Ullrich,Denns BiomarktandSPAR Express On Sundays, these grocery stores are very busy. There is often a queue outside the store. You can also buy food and drinks inSpätisand petrol stations. Grocery delivery services are closed on Sundays.2

title: Pharmacies and drug stores
text: Those train station pharmacies and drug stores are open on Sundays:3 Alexanderplatz(Mitte):Rossmann Friedrichstraße(Mitte):Rossmann Hauptbahnhof(Mitte):ApothekeandRossmann Lichtenberg:ApothekeandRossmann Ostbahnhof(Friedrichshain):ApothekeandRossmann Südkreuz(Schöneberg):Apothekeanddm Some other pharmaciesalso open on Sundays.

title: Restaurants, Spätis and flea markets
text: Most restaurants open on Sundays. Food delivery services also work. MostSpätisopen on Sundays. Many flea markets(Flohmarkt) only open on Sundays.

title: Museums
text: Some museums and tourist attractions stay open on Sundays.

title: Public transit
text: You can still use trains, trams and buses. Trains are less frequent.6

section: What is open on public holidays?
text: If a business can open on Sundays, it can open on public holidays. Some businesses still choose to close on public holidays. List of public holidays in Berlin

There are up to 8 Sunday shopping days (Verkaufsoffene Sonntage) per year. On those Sundays, shops can open from 13:00 to 20:00. Those days are announced in advance on Berlin.de.
